title: ProductEfficiency
description: ISO 25010-sourced quality archetype — Efficiency quality-in-use characteristic. Measures resources expended in relation to the accuracy and completeness with which users achieve goals. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms. Source: ISO/IEC 25010 (Quality in Use — Efficiency).

taskTimeEfficiency.description: Whether mean task completion time meets defined efficiency targets.

resourceUtilizationPerTask.description: Resources consumed per user task relative to the value delivered.

economicProductivity.description: Overall economic productivity — ratio of effective output to total resource cost.
